Changes.description: Newest first: what each new game version added, removed or changed.
Changes.title: Changes

crop.description: farm seeds only (null otherwise): what it grows into and how

growthTime.description: watered day phases to grow (a day has 5; a nearby Harvest Totem adds half a phase each)

harvests.description: how many times one seed can be harvested (random in this range)

season.description: the only season it grows in, unless a Farm Crop Grower or rotstone fertiliser is used

descriptionPlain.description: description without the game's text markup

meal.description: Meals and drinks only (null otherwise): how to make it and what it does

faith.description: faith gained when followers eat it

recipes.description: every ingredient combination the game accepts; empty for what the kitchen doesn't cook (a burned meal comes from overcooking)

satiation.description: how much a follower's hunger it fills (the game's own units)

satiationPlayer.description: how much it heals the player when eaten

stars.description: quality stars the cooking menu shows

namePlain.description: name without the game's text markup

seed.description: crops only: the seed item that grows it (null if none, or the game doesn't name that seed)

tags.description: food, fish, big_fish, meat, heart, gift, meal, drink

thumb.description: the icon fitted into 64x64 (null if no icon)

usedIn.description: where the item is used: structure costs, meal and drink recipes, ritual costs

alternative.description: pair rituals: the other choice of the same doctrine (the Crystal Doctrine unlocks both)

descriptionPlain.description: description without the game's text markup

faith.description: faith change when performed (base value, before cult traits)

group.description: how the ritual menu lists it; pair rituals come from a doctrine choice

namePlain.description: name without the game's text markup

thumb.description: the icon fitted into 64x64 (null if no icon)

trait.description: cult trait performing it can give

descriptionPlain.description: description without the game's text markup

namePlain.description: name without the game's text markup

thumb.description: the icon fitted into 64x64 (null if no icon)

Slim.description: v1/{lang}/{kind}.json: every entity of a kind with its name in one language (English if untranslated)
Slim.title: Slim

category.description: the game's structure category (FOOD, FAITH, ...), null if not buildable

descriptionPlain.description: description without the game's text markup

menu.description: build menu tab and section, e.g. Follower/Food, Faith/Sin, Aesthetic/Path; null if not in the build menu

namePlain.description: name without the game's text markup

thumb.description: the icon fitted into 64x64 (null if no icon)

upgradesTo.description: structures that upgrade from this one (the reverse of upgradesFrom)

info.description:
Items, structures and follower skins from *Cult of the Lamb*, taken from the game (version 1.5.26.1058, captured 2026-10-29T04:59:39Z). Static JSON: no keys, no rate limits, open CORS. Within `v1/` fields are only added, never removed.

What changed with each game version: [changes.json](/v1/changes.json). Field-by-field documentation and examples: the [README](https://github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api#readme).

Unofficial fan project; the game, its data and art belong to Massive Monster and Devolver Digital. Source: [github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api](https://github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api).

description.ar: يمكنك توزيع <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> على جميع أتباعك لزيادة <color=#FFD201>إخلاصهم.</color> سيمكنك أيضًا اكتساب +10 من العقيدة.
description.de: Verteile <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> an alle Anhänger, um ihre <color=#FFD201>Loyalität</color> zu erhöhen. Du wirst auch +10 Glauben erhalten.
description.en: Distribute <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> to all Followers to increase their <color=#FFD201>Loyalty.</color> You will also gain +10 Faith.
description.es: Reparte <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> entre los adeptos para aumentar su <color=#FFD201>lealtad</color>. También ganarás 10 de fe.
description.fr: Vous distribuez des <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> à tous vos adeptes pour augmenter leur <color=#FFD201>fidélité</color>. Vous gagnez également +10 de foi.
description.fr-CA: Vous distribuez des <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> à tous vos adeptes pour augmenter leur <color=#FFD201>fidélité</color>. Vous gagnez également +10 de foi.
description.it: Distribuisci <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> a tutti i membri del Culto per aumentarne la <color=#FFD201>Fedeltà</color>. +10 Fede.
description.ja: すべての信者に <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> を配布することで<color=#FFD201>忠誠心</color>を高める。また信仰を10得る
description.ko: <sprite name="icon_blackgold">를 모든 추종자에게 분배해 이들의 <color=#FFD201>충성심</color>을 상승시킵니다. 당신 또한 신앙을 +10 획득합니다.
description.nl: Verdeel <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> onder alle volgelingen om hun <color=#FFD201>loyaliteit</color> te verhogen. Je krijgt ook +10 geloof.
description.pt-BR: Distribua <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> para todos os Seguidores para aumentar a <color=#FFD201>Lealdade</color> deles. Você também ganhará +10 de Fé.
description.ru: Вы можете раздавать <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> последователям, тем самым повышая их <color=#FFD201>доверие</color>. Вера увеличивается на 10 ед.
description.tr: Takipçilerine <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> dağıtarak <color=#FFD201>Bağlılıklarını</color> artırırsın. Ayrıca İnanç 10 artar.
description.zh-CN: 将<sprite name="icon_blackgold">分送给所有教徒，提升他们的<color=#FFD201>忠诚度。</color>你也将获得信仰值 +10。
description.zh-TW: 將 <sprite name="icon_blackgold"> 分送給所有教徒，提升他們的<color=#FFD201>忠誠度。</color>你也將獲得信仰值 +10。

description.ar: يمكنك أداء <color=#FFD201>طقس</color> في مجمعك حيث يكون بوسعك السماح بسمو روح تابع إلى مستوى أعلى من الوجود. يكتسب جميع الأتباع <color=#FFD201>الإخلاص.</color>
description.de: Führe in deinem Tempel ein <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> durch, mit dem du den Geist eines Anhängers auf eine höhere Ebene des Seins aufsteigen lassen kannst. Alle Anhänger erhalten <color=#FFD201>Loyalität</color>.
description.en: Perform a <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> at your temple in which you can ascend a Followers spirit to a higher plane of existence. All Followers gain <color=#FFD201>Loyalty.</color>
description.es: Celebra un <color=#FFD201>ritual</color> en tu templo en el que puedes ascender el espíritu de un adepto a un plano superior de la existencia. Todos los adeptos ganan <color=#FFD201>lealtad</color>.
description.fr: <color=#FFD201>Rituel</color> sacrificiel à effectuer dans le Temple permettant à un adepte d'atteindre l'ascension de son âme. Tous les adeptes gagnent de la <color=#FFD201>fidélité</color>.
description.fr-CA: <color=#FFD201>Rituel</color> sacrificiel à effectuer dans le Temple permettant à un adepte d'atteindre l'ascension de son âme. Tous les adeptes gagnent de la <color=#FFD201>fidélité</color>.
description.it: Celebra un <color=#FFD201>rito</color> per far ascendere a un piano di esistenza superiore lo spirito di un membro del Culto, facendo ottenere <color=#FFD201>Fedeltà</color> agli altri membri.
description.ja: 信者の魂を高次の存在へと昇天させる<color=#FFD201>儀式</color>を教会堂で行う。すべての信者が<color=#FFD201>忠誠心</color>を得る
description.ko: 사원에서 <color=#FFD201>의식</color>을 거행해 추종자 하나의 영혼을 보다 높은 차원의 존재로 만들어줍니다. 모든 추종자들은 <color=#FFD201>충성심</color>을 얻습니다.
description.nl: Voer een <color=#FFD201>ritueel</color> uit in je tempel om de geest van een volgeling naar een hoger bestaansniveau te verheffen. Alle volgelingen worden <color=#FFD201>loyaler</color>.
description.pt-BR: Realize um <color=#FFD201>Ritual</color> em seu templo no qual você pode ascender o espírito de um seguidor para um plano de existência superior. Todos os seguidores ganharão <color=#FFD201>Lealdade</color>.
description.ru: Вы можете провести в храме <color=#FFD201>ритуал</color>, чтобы перевести дух своего последователя на другой уровень бытия и повысить <color=#FFD201>доверие</color> остальных.
description.tr: Tapınağında bir <color=#FFD201>Ayin</color> gerçekleştirerek bir Takipçi'nin daha üstün bir varoluş katına yükselmesini sağlarsın. Tüm Takipçilerin <color=#FFD201>Bağlılık</color>'ı artar.
description.zh-CN: 在你的圣殿举行<color=#FFD201>仪式</color>，让一位教徒的灵魂向更高层次的存在飞升。所有教徒都能获得<color=#FFD201>忠诚度。</color>
description.zh-TW: 在你的聖殿舉行<color=#FFD201>儀式</color>，讓一位教徒的靈魂飛昇到更高層次的存在。所有教徒都能獲得<color=#FFD201>忠誠度。</color>

description.en: A place for a Follower to sleep. Very unstable, will often collapse.
description.es: Para que tus adeptos duerman. Muy inestable, se rompe constantemente.
description.fr: Permet à un adepte de se reposer. Il s'abîmera rapidement.
description.fr-CA: Permet à un adepte de se reposer. Peu solide, il s'effondre souvent.
description.it: Un giaciglio per un membro del Culto. Molto instabile, si deteriora spesso.
description.ja: 信者が寝るための寝床。寝心地は悪く、壊れやすい
description.ko: 추종자들이 잠을 자는 곳입니다. 매우 불안정하며 가끔씩 무너집니다.
description.nl: Een plek waar een volgeling kan slapen. Heel onstabiel. Stort vaak in.
description.pt-BR: Um lugar para o Seguidor dormir. É muito instável e desaba com frequência.
description.ru: Место, где последователь может переночевать. Собран наскоро, часто разваливается.
description.tr: Bir Takipçi'nin uyuyabileceği bir yer. Oldukça dayanıksız, sık sık çöker.
description.zh-CN: 供一位教徒睡觉的地方，非常不稳定，会经常坍塌。
description.zh-TW: 供一位教徒睡覺的地方，非常不穩定，會經常顛塌

description.nl: Upgrade naar een stabieler onderkomen dat minder vaak instort.
